inputs.name: Use tick data for calculation
inputs.tooltip: When enabled, footprints are recalculated using bid and ask from tick data to accurately determine the direction of the trade volume for the last day in history calculation and for the next realtime calculation. This will only work on 1D and lower timeframes on history data and on any timeframes for realtime data.

inputs.name: Ignore zeros
inputs.tooltip: Levels with volume = 0 are not taken into account when calculating imbalances.

No re-sorting, sums or guessed row edges replace native fields. Internal built-in tick-data setting and calculation resolution are recorded; equivalence with request.footprint is UNVERIFIED.
